fact_definition: Reported issuer or third-party assertion. Estimates, translations and analyst judgments are separately labeled.

q2_2026.source: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings release and management report

ttm_harness_bridge_ntd_b.note: OCF-PPE is a diagnostic only. It does not normalize the N2/A14, advanced-packaging and overseas-fab capex cycle, working capital, subsidies or asset-lifecycle economics.

derived_diagnostics.ads_basis: 25,932,524,521 ordinary shares / 5 ordinary shares per ADR, retained from 2026-09-06 filing bridge

moat_and_demand_observations.observation: TrendForce estimated TSMC Q2 2026 foundry revenue at about US$40.2B and market share at 72.5%, with 5/4nm and 3nm capacity fully booked by AI GPU/XPU demand.
TSMC reported Q2 HPC at 66% of revenue and 2nm at 3% of wafer revenue in its first revenue quarter.
TSMC official monthly revenue showed August 2026 revenue of NT$514.8B, up 53.3% YoY, with January-August revenue up 39.3%.

Management expects FY2026 revenue growth slightly above 40% in US-dollar terms and has previously described a roughly 25% overall revenue CAGR framework through 2029. These are forward-looking estimates, not realized facts.

capital_observations.observation: Management raised 2026 capex guidance to US$60-64B from US$52-56B and expects the next three years to be materially more capital intensive than the prior three.
TSMC's announced Arizona investment plan totals about US$265B after an additional US$100B commitment; the company continues major leading-edge and packaging expansion in Taiwan as well.
Management has previously guided to overseas-fab gross-margin dilution of roughly 2-3 percentage points initially, potentially widening to 3-4 points, while N2 launch also carries early dilution.

concentration_and_integrity_observations.observation: 2025 Form 20-F disclosures indicate the top ten customers represented 78% of revenue; the largest and second-largest customers represented 19% and 17%, respectively.
concentration_and_integrity_observations.treatment: Customer concentration remains a Hard Veto investigation item; it is not assumed fatal in isolation.

concentration_and_integrity_observations.observation: The 2025 Form 20-F states management assessed ICFR as effective and Deloitte issued unqualified opinions on both consolidated financial statements and ICFR.
Overseas fabs reduce but do not eliminate Taiwan geographic concentration because the most advanced R&D and a large share of leading-edge capacity remain Taiwan-centered.

source_limits: The September 10 ADR price is a secondary historical-market reference and is not represented as an exchange-audited execution price.
USD translations of TTM native-NTD figures use 31.6 NTD/USD only as a valuation diagnostic; native NTD figures are the accounting observations.
Foundry market-share data is an independent industry estimate, not issuer-reported audited market share.
Management growth and capex outlooks are forward-looking estimates and are not scored as realized future facts.
